literal: On bingyin day Yelü Shiliang and others reported numbers of Zubu captives from the victory.
idiomatic: On bingyin day Yelü Shiliang and others reported the count of captives taken in defeating the Zubu.

literal: On wuchen day imperial halt at Lake Yanliu.
idiomatic: On wuchen day the court encamped at Lake Yanliu.

literal: On jisi day the Jurchen dispatched envoys to come with tribute.
idiomatic: On jisi day the Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On renshen day Yelü Shiliang campaigned against Wugu and defeated them.
idiomatic: On renshen day Yelü Shiliang attacked the Wugu and defeated them.

literal: On jiaxu day dispatched envoys to reward meritorious officers and soldiers.
idiomatic: On jiaxu day envoys were sent to reward the officers and soldiers who had distinguished themselves.

literal: Shiliang in campaigning against the Dilie De reached Qingni Gorge.
idiomatic: Shiliang pursued the Dilie De as far as Qingni Gorge.

literal: At the time the Yujue had already been pacified; the court discussed inward relocation of their people, but the Yujue, attached to their native soil and unwilling to move, then rebelled.
idiomatic: The Yujue had just been pacified when the court proposed resettling them inland, but they clung to their homeland and rebelled.

literal: Shiliang as punishment, having defeated the Dilie De, immediately exterminated their able-bodied men.
idiomatic: As punishment Shiliang, once he had broken the Dilie De, slaughtered their adult males.

literal: He drove the army across the Hela River to attack remnant bands; scouts were careless, and his general Bokuo gathered troops in dense forest and struck the Liao army unprepared.
idiomatic: He led his troops across the Hela River to pursue the remnants, but careless scouting let the rebel general Bokuo mass men in thick woods and fall on the Liao army unawares.

literal: The Liao army retreated slightly and formed battle lines on the river bend.
idiomatic: The Liao army fell back a short distance and formed ranks on the river bend.

literal: That night Bokuo came to raid.
idiomatic: That night Bokuo launched a night attack.

literal: Next day the Liao rear army arrived; Bokuo induced the Yujue people all to flee, and Shiliang pursued them until the army reached perilous terrain.
idiomatic: The next day Liao reinforcements arrived; Bokuo had incited the Yujue to scatter, and Shiliang pursued them into dangerous country.

literal: Bokuo had just blocked the pass and rested briefly; the Liao army scouts learned his location, but Shiliang did not promptly strike; Bokuo escaped on light horses.
idiomatic: Bokuo had halted in a defile to rest; scouts found him, but Shiliang failed to strike quickly and Bokuo fled on fast horses.

literal: They captured his baggage train and the Yujue people he had induced, and also moved the Xiabaili division people captured from the Dilie De, fortifying a city on the Luch River to settle them.
idiomatic: They took his baggage train and the Yujue he had won over, resettled the Xiabaili people captured from the Dilie De, and built a town on the Luch River for them.

literal: That month Xiao Yangge married the Princess of Nanping Commandery.
idiomatic: That month Xiao Yangge married the Princess of Nanping.

literal: Fifth month, on xinsi day, ordered Northern Chancellery chancellor Liu Sheng as commander-in-chief, Commissioner of Military Affairs Yelü Shiliang as deputy, and Palace Front inspector Xiao Qulie as supervisory commander to campaign against Goryeo.
idiomatic: On xinsi day of the fifth month Liu Sheng was appointed commander-in-chief, Yelü Shiliang deputy commander, and Xiao Qulie supervisory commander for a campaign against Goryeo.

literal: Sheng had first moved his family to a border prefecture, causing delay in the army schedule; he was recalled.
idiomatic: Sheng had moved his household to a frontier prefecture, delaying the campaign, and was recalled.

literal: Shiliang and Qulie were put in charge of the army to advance in attack.
idiomatic: Shiliang and Qulie were given overall command and marched to attack.

literal: Yelü Dezheng was made military commissioner of Liaoxing Army, and Xiao Nianguli military commissioner of Tiancheng Army.
idiomatic: Yelü Dezheng was appointed military commissioner of the Liaoxing Army and Xiao Nianguli military commissioner of the Tiancheng Army.

literal: Li Zhongju died; an edict granted funeral payment and consolation to his family.
idiomatic: Li Zhongju died, and an edict ordered funeral gifts and relief for his family.

literal: Sixth month, on gengxu day, the Emperor worshipped the sun according to rite.
idiomatic: On gengxu day of the sixth month the Emperor performed the sun-worship rite.

literal: Exchanging robes and horses with Madugu of Shixiong as tokens of friendship.
idiomatic: Robes and horses were exchanged with Madugu of Shixiong as a bond of friendship.

literal: Upper Capital regent Yelü Bage was made Northern Court deputy commissioner of military affairs.
idiomatic: Upper Capital regent Yelü Bage was appointed deputy commissioner of the Northern Court Military Affairs Commission.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, the Emperor again worshipped the sun, then favored and visited Autumn Mountain.
idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month the Emperor again performed the sun-worship rite, then went to Autumn Mountain.

literal: From eighth month deer-shooting until ninth month, again from guichou to xinyou, continuous hunting at Youbai, Suishi, Taibao, Xiangying, Song Mountain and other mountains.
idiomatic: From the eighth month through the ninth the court hunted deer, and from guichou to xinyou hunted continuously on Mount Youbai, Suishi, Taibao, Xiangying, Song Mountain, and others.

literal: On dingmao day made a pact of friendship with yilibi and Minister of War Xiao Rongning to strengthen the bond between ruler and minister.
idiomatic: On dingmao day the Emperor entered a pact of friendship with yilibi and Minister of War Xiao Rongning to deepen the bond between ruler and minister.

literal: On bingzi day made qigu drala xianwen Tiligu king of the Six Xi Divisions.
idiomatic: On bingzi day Tiligu, qigu drala xianwen, was appointed king of the Six Xi Divisions.

literal: Winter, tenth month, imperial halt at Talage Marsh.
idiomatic: In the tenth winter month the court encamped at Talage Marsh.

literal: Eleventh month, on gengshen day, an edict purged Eastern Capital monks, and ordered the Upper Capital, Central Capital, and the various palaces to select fifty-five thousand elite troops in preparation for eastern expedition.
idiomatic: On gengshen day of the eleventh month an edict culled Buddhist monks in the Eastern Capital and ordered the Upper Capital, Central Capital, and the palace households to furnish fifty-five thousand elite troops for the eastern campaign.

literal: Twelfth month, southern tour to Haiqiao.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month the court made a southern tour to Haiqiao.

literal: Returning, favored and visited Xian Prefecture.
idiomatic: On the return the court visited Xian Prefecture.

literal: Fifth year, spring, first month, on dingwei day, northern tour.
idiomatic: In the fifth year, on dingwei day of the first spring month, the court made a northern tour.

literal: On gengxu day Yelü Shiliang and Xiao Qulie fought Goryeo west of Guo Prefecture, defeated them, beheaded tens of thousands, and captured all their baggage.
idiomatic: On gengxu day Yelü Shiliang and Xiao Qulie fought Goryeo west of Guo Prefecture, broke them, took tens of thousands of heads, and seized all their baggage.

literal: On yimao day the army halted at Nanhai Army; Yelü Shiliang died in camp.
idiomatic: On yimao day the army reached Nanhai Army and Yelü Shiliang died in camp.

literal: On guiyou day imperial halt at Xuelin.
idiomatic: On guiyou day the court encamped at Xuelin.

literal: Second month, on jimao day, a Zubu chieftain came to court.
idiomatic: On jimao day of the second month a Zubu chieftain came to court.

literal: On xinsi day went to Sadai Marsh.
idiomatic: On xinsi day the court went to Sadai Marsh.

literal: On gengyin day former Eastern Capital army commander Yelü Hanliu was made right yilibi.
idiomatic: On gengyin day former Eastern Capital army commander Yelü Hanliu was appointed right yilibi.

literal: On wuxu day Prince Zongzhen was born.
idiomatic: On wuxu day Prince Zongzhen was born.

literal: Third month, on yimao day, Bigude chieftains Sabote, Saila, and others came with tribute.
idiomatic: On yimao day of the third month Bigude chieftains Sabote, Saila, and others came with tribute.

literal: On xinyou day prisons in all circuits were empty; an edict granted promotion in rank and gifts.
idiomatic: On xinyou day the prisons in every circuit stood empty, and an edict ordered promotions and gifts.

literal: On bingyin day former Northern Court great king Yelü Jingwen was made azha gezhi.
idiomatic: On bingyin day former Northern Court great king Yelü Jingwen was appointed azha gezhi.

literal: On xinwei day Tangut chief Kuikke came to surrender.
idiomatic: On xinwei day Tangut chief Kuikke submitted.

literal: Summer, fourth month, on yihai day, relief was given to the people of Zhao Prefecture.
idiomatic: On yihai day of the fourth summer month relief was given to the people of Zhao Prefecture.

literal: On wuyin day left yilibi Xiao Hezhuo was made Northern Court commissioner of military affairs, and Heluning deputy.
idiomatic: On wuyin day left yilibi Xiao Hezhuo was appointed Northern Court commissioner of military affairs, with Heluning as deputy.

literal: On gengchen day summer coolness at Gushu Marsh.
idiomatic: On gengchen day the court took the summer retreat at Gushu Marsh.

literal: Fifth month, on jiazi day, Minister Xiao Jiyin because of returning late from a mission had his office stripped.
idiomatic: On jiazi day of the fifth month Minister Xiao Jiyin was dismissed for returning late from an envoy mission.

literal: On dingmao day Geng Yuanji was made Commissioner of the Household.
idiomatic: On dingmao day Geng Yuanji was appointed commissioner of the household bureau.

literal: Sixth month, administrative secretary Wu Kechang was sent to inspect legal cases at Ba Prefecture.
idiomatic: In the sixth month administrative secretary Wu Kechang was sent to review criminal cases in Ba Prefecture.

literal: On dingchou day the Uyghur presented a peacock.
idiomatic: On dingchou day the Uyghur presented a peacock.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jiachen day, hunted at Red Mountain.
idiomatic: On jiachen day of the seventh autumn month the court hunted at Red Mountain.

literal: Eighth month, on bingzi day, favored and visited Huai Prefecture, performed rites at the various mausoleums.
idiomatic: On bingzi day of the eighth month the court visited Huai Prefecture and offered rites at the imperial tombs.

literal: On wuyin day returned to the Upper Capital.
idiomatic: On wuyin day the court returned to the Upper Capital.

literal: Ninth month, on guimao day, the Emperor's younger brother Nanjing regent Qin-Jin State King Longqing came to court; the Emperor personally went out to welcome and comfort him; reaching Shide Mountain, they then hunted together at Song Mountain.
idiomatic: On guimao day of the ninth month the Emperor's younger brother, Nanjing regent and Qin-Jin State King Longqing, came to court; the Emperor went out in person to welcome him, and at Mount Shide they hunted together on Song Mountain.

literal: On yichou day imperial halt at Xing Pass.
idiomatic: On yichou day the court encamped at Xing Pass.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on jiawu day, enfeoffed Qin-Jin State King Longqing's eldest son Zhage as Prince of Zhongshan Commandery and second son Suige as Prince of Le'an Commandery.
idiomatic: On jiawu day of the tenth winter month Longqing's eldest son Zhage was made Prince of Zhongshan and his second son Suige Prince of Le'an.

literal: Eleventh month, on xinchou new moon, made associate state counselor Ma Baozhong concurrent commissioner of military affairs and director of state history compilation.
idiomatic: On the xinchou new moon of the eleventh month associate state counselor Ma Baozhong was made concurrent commissioner of military affairs and director of the state history.

literal: On dingsi day made Northern Court linya Xiao Weiwo imperial maternal uncle xianyin.
idiomatic: On dingsi day Northern Court linya Xiao Weiwo was appointed imperial maternal uncle xianyin.

literal: Twelfth month, on yiyou day, Qin-Jin State King Longqing returning died at Bei'an; when the death report arrived the Emperor grieved deeply and suspended court for seven days.
idiomatic: On yiyou day of the twelfth month Qin-Jin State King Longqing died at Bei'an on his way back; when word reached the court the Emperor was stricken with grief and suspended audience for seven days.

literal: On dingyou day Song dispatched Zhang Xun and Wang Chengde to come congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.
idiomatic: On dingyou day Song sent Zhang Xun and Wang Chengde to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.

literal: That year jinshi Sun Jie and forty-seven others were passed and granted degree.
idiomatic: That year Sun Jie and forty-seven others passed the examinations.

literal: Sixth year, spring, first month, on guimao day, went to Zhuizi River.
idiomatic: In the sixth year, on guimao day of the first spring month, the court went to the Zhuizi River.

literal: Second month, on jiaxu day, because Princess Saige killed an innocent maidservant and imperial son-in-law Xiao Tuyu could not manage the household, the Princess was demoted to county mistress and Tuyu's position as co-equal chief councillor was stripped.
idiomatic: On jiaxu day of the second month Princess Saige was demoted to county mistress and Xiao Tuyu was stripped of his co-equal chief councillor title because she had killed an innocent maidservant and he could not keep his household in order.

literal: On dingchou day an edict ordered imperial maternal uncle tent xianwen Xiao Aiwo to lead his division's troops on eastern expedition against Goryeo; the imperial maternal uncle office affairs would be administered by the supervisory commander in his stead.
idiomatic: On dingchou day an edict ordered imperial maternal uncle xianwen Xiao Aiwo to lead his command east against Goryeo, with the supervisory commander acting in his office during the campaign.

literal: On gengchen day made Southern Court linya Niehe Southern Court great king.
idiomatic: On gengchen day Southern Court linya Niehe was appointed Southern Court great king.

literal: Third month, on yisi day, went to Xian Prefecture and buried Qin-Jin State King Longqing.
idiomatic: On yisi day of the third month the court went to Xian Prefecture and buried Qin-Jin State King Longqing.

literal: Performed rites at the Xian and Qian mausoleums.
idiomatic: Sacrifice was offered at the Xian and Qian mausoleums.

literal: Posthumously enregistered Longqing as Imperial Elder Brother.
idiomatic: Longqing was posthumously enregistered as Imperial Elder Brother.

literal: Summer, fourth month, on xinmao day, enfeoffed Longqing's youngest son Xiejianu as Prince of Changsha Commandery; Commissioner of Military Affairs Prince of Qishui Yelü Zhixin was put in temporary charge of all traveling palace deployments.
idiomatic: On xinmao day of the fourth summer month Longqing's youngest son Xiejianu was made Prince of Changsha, and Commissioner of Military Affairs Prince of Qishui Yelü Zhixin was appointed acting director of all traveling palace deployments.

literal: On renchen day forbade widowed women remarriage.
idiomatic: On renchen day an edict forbade widows from remarrying.

literal: On bingshen day went to Liang Pass.
idiomatic: On bingshen day the court went to Liang Pass.

literal: Fifth month, on wuxu new moon, ordered Commissioner of Military Affairs Xiao Hezhuo as commander-in-chief, Han traveling palace deployment director Wang Jizhong as deputy, Palace Front inspector Xiao Qulie as supervisory commander to campaign against Goryeo.
idiomatic: On the wuxu new moon of the fifth month Xiao Hezhuo was appointed commander-in-chief, Wang Jizhong deputy commander, and Xiao Qulie supervisory commander for a campaign against Goryeo.

literal: Next day granted Hezhuo a sword, enabling him to execute on his own authority.
idiomatic: The next day Hezhuo was given a sword conferring authority to execute at his discretion.

literal: On bingwu day reviewed prisoners.
idiomatic: On bingwu day prisoners were reviewed.

literal: On jiyou day established four-accounts chief xianwen.
idiomatic: On jiyou day chief xianwen posts were established for the four accounts.

literal: On jiayin day made Nanjing army commander Xiao Hui right yilibi.
idiomatic: On jiayin day Nanjing army commander Xiao Hui was appointed right yilibi.

literal: On yimao day sacrificed at Muye Mountain and Huang River.
idiomatic: On yimao day sacrifice was offered at Muye Mountain and on the Huang River.

literal: On yichou day imperial halt at Nine-Tier Terrace.
idiomatic: On yichou day the court encamped at the Nine-Tier Terrace.

literal: Sixth month, on wuchen new moon, Noble Consort Xiao was granted death and buried west of Rabbit Mountain.
idiomatic: On the wuchen new moon of the sixth month Noble Consort Xiao was ordered to take her own life and was buried west of Rabbit Mountain.

literal: Several days later great wind rose over the tomb, daylight darkened, great thunder and lightning and rain did not cease for more than a month.
idiomatic: Several days later a great wind rose over the tomb, daylight turned dark, and thunder, lightning, and unceasing rain lasted more than a month.

literal: That month Nanjing various counties had locusts.
idiomatic: That month locusts afflicted the counties of Nanjing.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on xinhai day, went to Autumn Mountain.
idiomatic: On xinhai day of the seventh autumn month the court went to Autumn Mountain.

literal: Dispatched Minister of Rites Liu Jing, Hanlin academician Wu Shuda, drafter of edicts Qiu Zhengji, diarist Cheng Zhu, Ministry of Personnel vice bureau director Nan Chengyan, and Ministry of Rites vice bureau director Wang Jingyun to inspect legal cases by separate routes.
idiomatic: Liu Jing, Wu Shuda, Qiu Zhengji, Cheng Zhu, Nan Chengyan, and Wang Jingyun were sent along separate routes to review criminal cases.

literal: On xinyou day, at the request of the Southwestern Pacification commissioner, established Ningren County at Sheng Prefecture.
idiomatic: On xinyou day, at the Southwestern Pacification Commissioner's request, Ningren County was established in Sheng Prefecture.

literal: Ninth month, on gengzi day returned to Upper Capital; because Prince Shusi was born, general amnesty.
idiomatic: On gengzi day of the ninth month the court returned to the Upper Capital and proclaimed a general amnesty on the birth of Prince Shusi.

literal: On dingwei day made imperial son-in-law Xiao Lian, military commissioner Huage, drafter of edicts Qiu Zhengji, and Yang Ji envoys and deputies to congratulate Song on birthday and New Year's Day.
idiomatic: On dingwei day Xiao Lian, Huage, Qiu Zhengji, and Yang Ji were appointed chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on the Emperor's birthday and New Year's Day.

literal: On yimao day Xiao Hezhuo and others attacked Goryeo's Xinghua Army but did not take it and returned the army.
idiomatic: On yimao day Xiao Hezhuo and others failed to take Goryeo's Xinghua Army and withdrew.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on dingmao day, Nanjing circuit had famine; exempted grain and gave relief in Yun, Ying, Shuo, Hong and other prefectures.
idiomatic: On dingmao day of the tenth winter month famine struck the Nanjing circuit, and grain levies were remitted and relief distributed in Yun, Ying, Shuo, Hong, and other prefectures.

literal: On xinwei day hunted at Huazi River.
idiomatic: On xinwei day the court hunted on the Huazi River.

literal: On gengyin day imperial halt at Dali Mountain.
idiomatic: On gengyin day the court encamped at Mount Dali.

literal: Eleventh month, on yimao day, Jian Prefecture military commissioner Shi Kuangbi died.
idiomatic: On yimao day of the eleventh month Jian Prefecture military commissioner Shi Kuangbi died.

literal: Twelfth month, on dingmao day the Emperor returned to the Upper Capital on light horses.
idiomatic: On dingmao day of the twelfth month the Emperor rode back to the Upper Capital with a light escort.

literal: On wuzi day Song dispatched Li Xingjian and Zhang Xin to come congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.
idiomatic: On wuzi day Song sent Li Xingjian and Zhang Xin to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.

literal: Next day Song Feng Yuan and Zhang Lun came to congratulate New Year's Day.
idiomatic: The next day Song sent Feng Yuan and Zhang Lun to congratulate New Year's Day.
